title: Node announce persistence reboot/corruption/rollback tests
description: Child 3 of ta0c decomposition (Rust). Tests for children 1+2: (a) reboot — pins and origin-seq floors survive Node restart (store re-open rebuilds cache); (b) corruption — tampered record fails closed with the store error, never re-pins a different key for the same IID; (c) rollback — restored older floor/state snapshot fails closed; exactly-one-side present fails closed; (d) eviction interaction — pinned eviction does not silently lower a durable floor; (e) replay — an old origin-signed Announce replayed through an authenticated relay is rejected after restart using the durable floor. Style: mirror rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs oscore store tests (private_test_dir, reopen, mutate file, reopen, assert error).
